summary: Tested new Forms + Messages features end-to-end. Backend: 8/8 pytest cases passed (forms CRUD, public schema GET with CORS, valid submit 200, missing-required 422, OPTIONS preflight CORS, unread-count, mark-read, delete). Frontend: login page has no register link; Forms/Messages nav visible; unread badge (messages-unread-badge=1) appears after public submit; Forms CRUD flow works (create -> editor -> add/type=select+options/required+showInList toggles/reorder/save/reload persists 4 fields/delete); Website integration URL boxes + copy testids present; public GET schema via page.request returned 4 fields; POST missing required -> 422; POST valid -> 200; Messages inbox shows only showInList fields (Name, Email) with Message/priority hidden; More details reveals hidden fields; form filter dropdown lists all forms; delete message removes card; regression pass for Scenes/Pancartes/Flows.

ui_bugs.issue: Auto-slug key from label does NOT work when a brand-new field is added: newly added field has key='field_{n+1}' (e.g. field_4) while slug(label)='new_field', so autoKey condition (!f.key || f.key === slug(f.label)) is false and key never rewrites when the user edits the label. Only the pre-seeded default fields (name/email/message) exhibit the documented auto-slug behavior. Fix: initialize new field with key=slug(label) or treat the placeholder pattern /^field_\d+$/ as unset for auto-slug purposes.

integration_issues.issue: Badge does not decrement immediately when the message is opened/read from the Messages page itself; it only refreshes on next route change or the 20s poll. This matches the note in the request so it is acceptable, but a UX improvement would be to also refetch unread-count after markRead/toggle/delete inside Messages.jsx.

action_items: Optional: Fix FormEditor auto-slug so newly added fields also get key auto-derived from label (treat placeholder key field_<n> as empty).
Optional UX: refetch /submissions/unread-count from Messages.jsx after markRead / toggle / delete so the badge updates without navigating away.
critical_code_review_comments: FormEditor onLabelChange autoKey logic misses the 'newly added field' case because initial key 'field_<n>' never equals slug(label).

Messages.jsx keeps its own local subs state and mutates read=true optimistically, but the AppLayout unread badge is not notified until route change / 20s poll -> consider a shared context or event to sync.
seed_data_creation: Created/deleted a TEST form + one submission via public API during testing; cleaned up.
